# Modul:
#   o6_17 – Vertragszeitraum, Flächenänderungen, Übernahme, Sanktionen und Abwicklung
package oepul.o6_17

gen := cfg.general

contract_duration_years := contract_period_row.duration_years

contract_end_date := gen.contract_end_date

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Flächenabgang: Toleranz jährlich 5 %, höchstens 5 ha, jedenfalls 0,5 ha (Bezug: Vorjahresfläche)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
reduction_cfg := gen.area_reduction_tolerance

area_reduction_tolerance_ha := max([
	min([reduction_cfg.max_share_per_year * o617.previous_year_committed_area_ha, reduction_cfg.max_ha_per_year]),
	reduction_cfg.always_allowed_ha_per_year,
])

area_reduction_ha := max([
	0,
	(o617.previous_year_committed_area_ha - o617.committed_area_ha) - object.get(o617, "reduction_exempt_ha", 0),
])

area_reduction_repayment_required if area_reduction_ha > area_reduction_tolerance_ha

# Rückzahlungspflicht für die gesamten mit der Maßnahme belegten Differenzflächen
area_reduction_repayment_area_ha := area_reduction_ha if area_reduction_repayment_required

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Vorzeitiger Ausstieg aus der mehrjährigen Maßnahme
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
repayment_free_exit_reasons := {"loss_of_control", "force_majeure", "permanent_circumstances", "revision_clause"}

early_exit if {
	d := object.get(o617, "exit_date", null)
	is_string(d)
	d < contract_end_date
}

early_exit_repayment_required if {
	early_exit
	not object.get(o617, "exit_reason", "") in repayment_free_exit_reasons
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Maßnahmenübernahme (bis 15.04., 2023 und 2028 bis 17.04.; Ausweitung max. 50 %)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
takeover := object.get(o617, "takeover", null)

takeover_deadline(y) := sprintf("%d-%s", [y, gen.measure_takeover.deadline_mmdd_special_years]) if y in {s | some s in gen.measure_takeover.special_years}

takeover_deadline(y) := sprintf("%d-%s", [y, gen.measure_takeover.deadline_mmdd]) if not y in {s | some s in gen.measure_takeover.special_years}

takeover_permitted if {
	is_object(takeover)
	takeover.date <= takeover_deadline(to_number(substring(takeover.date, 0, 4)))
	object.get(takeover, "expansion_share", 0) <= gen.measure_takeover.max_expansion_share
	object.get(takeover, "taker_already_participating", false) == false
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Inhaltliche Sanktionen (§ 48 GSP-AV, Stufenschema)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
findings := object.get(o617, "findings", [])

findings_this_year := [f | some f in findings; f.year == application_year]

escalated_stage(f) := min([f.base_stage + object.get(f, "prior_occurrences_same_obligation", 0), 7])

stage_percent(stage) := row.reduction_percent_until_2026 if {
	application_year < 2027
	some row in gen.sanction_stages
	row.stage == stage
}

stage_percent(stage) := row.reduction_percent_from_2027 if {
	application_year >= 2027
	some row in gen.sanction_stages
	row.stage == stage
}

content_reduction_percent := min([100, sum([stage_percent(escalated_stage(f)) | some f in findings_this_year])])

full_reduction_this_year if content_reduction_percent == 100

full_reductions_in_period := object.get(o617, "previous_full_reductions", 0) + 1 if full_reduction_this_year

full_reductions_in_period := object.get(o617, "previous_full_reductions", 0) if not full_reduction_this_year

exclusion_from_measure if full_reductions_in_period >= gen.exclusion_after_full_reductions

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Übererklärung (§ 46 GSP-AV)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
declared_area_ha := base_premium_area_ha

determined_area_ha := sum([object.get(p, "determined_area_ha", p.area_ha) | some p in parcels; base_premium_eligible(p)])

overdeclaration_ha := max([0, declared_area_ha - determined_area_ha])

overdeclaration_sanction_applies if overdeclaration_ha > gen.overdeclaration.threshold_share * determined_area_ha

overdeclaration_sanction_applies if overdeclaration_ha > gen.overdeclaration.threshold_ha

overdeclaration_payment_basis_ha := max([0, determined_area_ha - (gen.overdeclaration.penalty_factor * overdeclaration_ha)]) if overdeclaration_sanction_applies

overdeclaration_payment_basis_ha := determined_area_ha if not overdeclaration_sanction_applies

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Höhere Gewalt: Geltendmachung binnen drei Wochen (§ 6 Abs. 2 GSP-AV)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
force_majeure_events := object.get(o617, "force_majeure_events", [])

force_majeure_notified_in_time(ev) if {
	able_ns := time.parse_ns("2006-01-02", ev.able_to_notify_date)
	notified_ns := time.parse_ns("2006-01-02", ev.notification_date)
	notified_ns - able_ns <= ((gen.force_majeure_notification_days * 24) * 3600) * 1000000000
}

violations contains v if {
	some ev in force_majeure_events
	not force_majeure_notified_in_time(ev)
	v := {"rule_id": "O6_17-GSPAV-6-FORCE-MAJEURE-NOTICE", "parcel_id": null, "message": "Höhere Gewalt nicht binnen drei Wochen geltend gemacht"}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Gesamtentscheidung
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
default first_participation_year := false

default is_livestock_farm := false

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
decision := {
	"measure": "o6_17",
	"application_year": application_year,
	"first_participation_year": first_participation_year,
	"access_violations": access_violations,
	"violations": violations,
	"is_livestock_farm": is_livestock_farm,
	"premium_total_eur": premium_total_eur,
	"modulation_factor": modulation_factor,
	"soil_samples_required": [n | n := soil_samples_required],
}

# Modul:
#   o6_17 – Eigenschaft als tierhaltender Betrieb (RGVE je Hektar Futterfläche)
package oepul.o6_17

species_groups := object.get(input, ["livestock", "species_groups"], [])

# RGVE-Schlüssel (Merkblatt Kapitel 11 / SRL Anhang A / § 21 Abs. 4 GSP-AV)
rgve_row(g) := row if {
	some row in cfg.rgve_key.rgve_conversion
	row.key == object.get(g, "rgve_category", "")
	row.counts_for_livestock_status == true
}

# Nur im Inland gehaltene Tiere sind anrechenbar (SRL 1.4.2.2)
kept_in_austria(g) if object.get(g, "kept_in_austria", true) == true

rgve_total := sum([n | some g in species_groups; kept_in_austria(g); row := rgve_row(g); n := g.animal_count * row.rgve_per_head])

# Futterfläche = Summe der Grünland- und Ackerfutterflächen
forage_area_ha := grassland_area_ha + arable_forage_area_ha

livestock_density_rgve_per_ha := rgve_total / forage_area_ha if forage_area_ha > 0

is_livestock_farm if livestock_density_rgve_per_ha >= cfg.rgve_key.livestock_density_threshold_rgve_per_ha

# Modul:
#   o6_17 – Prämienberechnung (Grundprämie, Zuschlag artenreiches Grünland, Modulation, Obergrenze)
package oepul.o6_17

rates := cfg.premium_rates

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Grundprämie: umbruchsfähiges Grünland mit Hangneigung < 18 %, gestaffelt nach Grünlandzahl
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
base_premium_eligible(p) if {
	is_grassland(p)
	field_use_row(p)
	is_number(p.slope_percent)
	p.slope_percent < rates.slope_threshold_percent
	is_number(object.get(p, "grassland_figure", null))
	not gloez_conversion_ban(p)
	not parcel_excluded_general(p)
}

base_rate_eur_per_ha(p) := row.eur_per_ha if {
	some row in rates.base_premium_rates
	year_in_range(application_year, row)
	value_at_least(p.grassland_figure, row.grassland_figure_min)
	value_below(p.grassland_figure, row.grassland_figure_max_exclusive)
}

base_premium_parcel_eur[pid] := amount if {
	some p in parcels
	base_premium_eligible(p)
	pid := p.parcel_id
	amount := p.area_ha * base_rate_eur_per_ha(p)
}

base_premium_area_ha := sum([p.area_ha | some p in parcels; base_premium_eligible(p)])

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Optionaler Zuschlag artenreiches Grünland (Code AGL)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
agl_slope_class(p) := "lt18" if p.slope_percent < rates.slope_threshold_percent

agl_slope_class(p) := "ge18" if p.slope_percent >= rates.slope_threshold_percent

agl_rate_eur_per_ha(p) := row.eur_per_ha if {
	some row in rates.agl_premium_rates
	row.slope_class == agl_slope_class(p)
	year_in_range(application_year, row)
}

agl_requested(p) if field_use_attr(p, "agl_automatic") == true

agl_requested(p) if {
	field_use_attr(p, "agl_requires_code_and_survey") == true
	cfg.lists.agl.code in parcel_codes(p)
}

kennart_matches(k, name) if lower(trim_space(name)) == lower(k.common_name)

kennart_matches(k, name) if {
	some alt in k.alternative_names
	lower(trim_space(name)) == lower(alt)
}

kennart_matches(k, name) if {
	some s in k.scientific_names
	lower(trim_space(name)) == lower(s)
}

section_species(section) := {k.id | some name in object.get(section, "kennarten", []); some k in cfg.kennarten.species; kennart_matches(k, name)}

agl_sections(p) := object.get(p, ["agl_survey", "sections"], [])

kennarten_sections_ok(p) if {
	count(agl_sections(p)) > 0
	every section in agl_sections(p) {
		count(section_species(section)) >= cfg.kennarten.minimum_species_per_section
	}
}

first_use_is_mowing(p) if object.get(p, ["operations", "first_use_type"], "") == "mowing"

agl_documented(p) if object.get(p, ["agl_survey", "documented"], false) == true

agl_conditions_met(p) if field_use_attr(p, "agl_automatic") == true

agl_conditions_met(p) if {
	field_use_attr(p, "agl_requires_code_and_survey") == true
	kennarten_sections_ok(p)
	first_use_is_mowing(p)
	agl_documented(p)
}

# GLÖZ 2/4/9 schließen den Zuschlag AGL nicht aus
agl_eligible(p) if {
	is_grassland(p)
	field_use_attr(p, "is_bergmaehder") == false
	is_number(p.slope_percent)
	agl_requested(p)
	agl_conditions_met(p)
	not parcel_excluded_general(p)
	agl_rate_eur_per_ha(p)
}

mown_grassland_ha := sum([p.area_ha | some p in parcels; is_mown_grassland(p)])

is_mown_grassland(p) if {
	is_grassland(p)
	field_use_attr(p, "is_mown") == true
	field_use_attr(p, "is_bergmaehder") == false
}

agl_cap_row := row if {
	some row in rates.agl_area_caps
	year_in_range(application_year, row)
}

agl_area_cap_ha := max([agl_cap_row.max_share_of_mown_grassland * mown_grassland_ha, agl_cap_row.minimum_cap_ha])

agl_requested_area_ha := sum([p.area_ha | some p in parcels; agl_eligible(p)])

agl_paid_share := 1 if agl_requested_area_ha <= agl_area_cap_ha

agl_paid_share := agl_area_cap_ha / agl_requested_area_ha if agl_requested_area_ha > agl_area_cap_ha

agl_premium_parcel_eur[pid] := amount if {
	some p in parcels
	agl_eligible(p)
	pid := p.parcel_id
	amount := (p.area_ha * agl_rate_eur_per_ha(p)) * agl_paid_share
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Prämienfähigkeit von Flächenzugängen (ab 2026: max. 50 % auf Basis 2025, jedenfalls 5 ha)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
area_addition_cfg := cfg.general.area_addition_limits

premium_eligible_area_limit_ha := limit if {
	application_year > area_addition_cfg.reference_year
	ref := o617.committed_area_2025_ha
	is_number(ref)
	increase := max([ref * area_addition_cfg.max_increase_share, area_addition_cfg.always_allowed_increase_ha])
	limit := (ref + increase) + object.get(o617, "additions_previously_committed_ha", 0)
}

addition_scale := base_premium_area_ha_limited / base_premium_area_ha if base_premium_area_ha > 0

addition_scale := 1 if base_premium_area_ha == 0

base_premium_area_ha_limited := min([base_premium_area_ha, premium_eligible_area_limit_ha])

base_premium_area_ha_limited := base_premium_area_ha if not premium_eligible_area_limit_ha

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Modulation (Betriebsgröße, Heimfläche ohne Almweideflächen)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
modulation_area_ha := utilised_area_excl_alpine_ha

tier_upper(a, t) := a if t.to_ha == null

tier_upper(_, t) := t.to_ha if is_number(t.to_ha)

tier_overlap(a, t) := max([0, min([a, tier_upper(a, t)]) - t.from_ha])

modulation_factor := 1 if modulation_area_ha <= 0

modulation_factor := f if {
	modulation_area_ha > 0
	weighted := sum([w | some t in cfg.general.modulation_tiers; w := tier_overlap(modulation_area_ha, t) * t.payment_share])
	f := weighted / modulation_area_ha
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Obergrenze für Flächenzahlungen je Schlag (allgemeine Obergrenze)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
area_payment_cap_eur_per_ha := row.eur_per_ha if {
	some row in cfg.general.area_payment_caps
	row.scope == "general"
	year_in_range(application_year, row)
}

parcel_gross_eur(pid) := (object.get(base_premium_parcel_eur, pid, 0) * addition_scale) + object.get(agl_premium_parcel_eur, pid, 0)

premium_parcel_ids := {pid | some pid, _ in base_premium_parcel_eur} | {pid | some pid, _ in agl_premium_parcel_eur}

parcel_by_id(pid) := p if {
	some p in parcels
	p.parcel_id == pid
}

parcel_cap_room_eur(pid) := room if {
	p := parcel_by_id(pid)
	room := max([0, (area_payment_cap_eur_per_ha * p.area_ha) - object.get(p, "other_area_payments_eur", 0)])
}

premium_parcel_eur[pid] := amount if {
	some pid in premium_parcel_ids
	amount := min([parcel_gross_eur(pid) * modulation_factor, parcel_cap_room_eur(pid)])
}

premium_total_before_modulation_eur := sum([parcel_gross_eur(pid) | some pid in premium_parcel_ids])

premium_total_eur := 0 if premium_blocked_by_access_conditions

premium_total_eur := sum([a | some a in premium_parcel_eur]) if not premium_blocked_by_access_conditions

# Von der Gewährung kann abgesehen werden, wenn der Betrag 50 Euro nicht überschreitet
payment_may_be_withheld_minimum if premium_total_eur <= cfg.general.minimum_payment_eur
